title: Man Intentionally Crashes into Lake During Police Chase
description:
On November 23, 2021, an intoxicated male was offering shots of alcohol to other people in Cumberland, WI. When police arrived, they discovered his license was suspended. He refused to comply with any commands and then told the officer he was going to take off if she touches her radio.
